about_the_game:
Hotel Galactic is a cozy management game where you transform a rundown intergalactic hotel into a thriving tourist destination. Blending wholesome nostalgia with modern fairy tale magic, Hotel Galactic invites you into a lovingly crafted world inspired by classic anime pictures, brought to life with stunning hand-painted visuals and beautifully animated details.

In this demo, you arrive just before Hotel Galactic’s grand reopening, right when things are barely holding together. With time running out, Gustav, Maklo, and the rest of the crew need all the help they can get. Jump in to restore the hotel, welcome your first guests, and pull off the perfect dinner service. Build, craft, decorate, and manage your team - all while getting a first glimpse of the stories, friendships, and little moments that make Hotel Galactic feel like home.

What can you do in the demo?

  • Experience about 2 hours of wholesome content filled with creativity, charm, and surprises

  • Discover a unique self-contained demo story that teases the world without spoiling the full game

  • Help run the hotel alongside Sparn, his father Tukyuk, Maklo, and Gustav

  • Construct new rooms and elevators to expand your space

  • Craft furniture and decorate every empty corner to your heart’s content

  • Harvest resources from the island to aid in rebuilding and repairs

  • Grow your own plants and produce in the small backyard garden

  • Hire new workers to expand the crew and keep things running smoothly

  • Organize your team’s priorities and tend to their needs

  • Meet different alien species like the Derrets, the Toravis, and the Pingtons

The doors to Hotel Galactic are finally open, and there’s no telling what surprises await inside. With each room fixed up and every guest you meet, you’ll get a glimpse of the warmth and wonder at the heart of this world. But this is just the beginning - the stage is set, and soon, more stories will unfold, more characters will arrive, and the hotel’s true magic will come to life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / Phenom x4 955
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Zen 2 4c/8t, 2.4-3.5GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 RDNA 2 CUs, 1.6GHz
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
